name: ANSI/IEEE transformer-fed indicator lamp symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for transformer-fed indicator lamp, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The transformer-fed lamp form identifies an indicator assembly with a documented internal voltage-conversion arrangement. Wiring uses the assembly input rating, while the internal lamp function explains the indication.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Separate assembly input voltage from internal lamp voltage.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A lamp's built-in transformer is different from a separately supplied panel control transformer.
